text: Romanian Deadlift belongs to the Audit lower-body group group. Each activity keeps its own sets, notes, presets, and history.
A family is an organizational group, such as Row or Run. The activity you log owns its own sets, notes, presets, and history.
Related Activities can link, move, or detach activities and create a variation. Those actions never combine histories. Merge Activities is a separate action for true duplicates.
